title: Finite Bonferroni horizon and capped fingerprint checkpoints

claims.statement: The analytic algorithm and complete work accounting in proof.md and fingerprints.md solve the full supplied-P pairing inversion task with probability at least0.39 under the sole disclosed SHA512 random-function idealization,within2^(6437/50) reference dense Fp12 equivalents at fixed C=20000. Peak storage<2^35 bytes,nonuniform advice zero. Every outcome is work-capped;all setup,failed probes,hashes,lookups,transfers,verification and G2 output are charged.
